reading.title: Challenge: Public Input on Life and the World in 2075
reading.summary: NASA’s Transformational Tools and Technologies (TTT) is gathering public perspectives on life today and how the world may change by 2075. This challenge asks for conceptual ideas about life in 2075 across four challenge topics. news.title: More climate money for Africa? Europe says use what's already pledged
news.summary: African countries at the UN climate summit in Turkey are demanding more funding from developed nations to help them cope with climate change.
